title: Wire system pages, collaboration, report builder, and view designer to backend API
body:
System admin pages were empty stubs, collaboration data was hardcoded, ReportBuilder used mock fields, and ViewDesigner save was a no-op `console.log`. All now use real `dataSource` calls.

### System Admin Pages (P0)
- `UserManagementPage`, `OrgManagementPage`, `RoleManagementPage`: fetch via `dataSource.find('sys_*')`, wire Add/Delete buttons to `create`/`delete`
- `AuditLogPage`: read-only fetch with `$orderby: 'createdAt desc'`
- All use `useAdapter()` from context — no prop threading needed since pages are already inside `AdapterProvider`

### Collaboration Data (P1)
- **AppHeader**: `MOCK_PRESENCE_USERS` / `DEMO_ACTIVITIES` replaced with API fetch from `sys_presence` / `sys_activity`, graceful fallback to defaults
- **RecordDetailView**: `MOCK_RECORD_VIEWERS` replaced with `sys_presence` filtered by `recordId`; comments now persist via `dataSource.create/delete/update('sys_comment', ...)`

### ReportBuilder Fields (P2)
- `MOCK_FIELDS` replaced with `useMemo` deriving fields from `useMetadata().objects` keyed on report's `objectName` / `dataSource.object`:

```tsx
const availableFields = useMemo(() => {
  const objName = reportData?.objectName || reportData?.dataSource?.object;
  const objDef = objects.find((o) => o.name === objName);
  if (objDef?.fields) { /* map to { name, label, type } */ }
  return FALLBACK_FIELDS;
}, [reportData, objects]);
```

### ViewDesigner Save (P3)
- `handleSave` calls `dataSource.create('sys_view', config)` or `dataSource.update('sys_view', viewId, config)` instead of logging

### Tests
- 19 new tests across 3 files: `SystemPages.test.tsx` (9), `ViewDesignerSave.test.tsx` (2), `ReportDynamicFields.test.tsx` (8)
- All 302 existing tests unaffected

### ROADMAP
- Updated `ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md` with resolved gaps G10–G13
